dedupe_keys.name: sofiaplan map of trees in sofia municipality machine learning tree index

description: The map of trees in Sofia Municipality, made by the municipal planning enterprise Sofiaplan, gives open GIS data on almost all trees in the municipality to support a public register of long-lived vegetation and citizen involvement in monitoring and planning it. It counts over 5.5 million trees in the municipality, of which over 640,000 are in the city of Sofia. The trees were detected in 3,671 georeferenced orthophotos at 10 cm resolution taken in autumn 2020, provided by GIS Sofia, using the DeepForest detection algorithm (a RetinaNet variant) retrained on over 500 hand-indexed trees; it found crowns in 95 percent of the images. Each tree has a centroid as its assumed planting point, crown diameter and projected crown area, a type (broadleaf, conifer or undetermined), elevation from a Sofiaplan terrain model, and its administrative district and planning unit, and statistics are given by district, planning zone and vegetation type (park, street, yard). Checked against 6,873 field-surveyed trees, accuracy is over 80 percent. The data is free from the Sofiaplan data API as GeoJSON crown polygons, under the site's terms for reuse of materials. Caveats: crowns wider than 20 m were set aside for checking, some areas were not indexed, and species are not identified. Coverage is Sofia Municipality. It supports urban heat and green infrastructure planning and storm damage risk to streets and power lines; related records are the Copenhagen street trees and the Buenos Aires trees in green spaces.
